neper.notes: ROUND 74 (merge of lanes h and i): sheet = lane h's 1.75 times grown Neper cells plus lane i's looks.pad_neper(30, 36) (pointer aims land on the head and the first row); the 3 px focus ring is now whole under the label notch (control.e notched(): the cut that hides the top edge behind the label starts at the edge, not half a line above it, so the ring, which lies outside the edge, is no longer overdrawn; the label text hangs over the ring). Focus and both open cells (Neper and NeperDark, 1x and 1.5x) viewed: ring continuous, all six list rows shown. Windows, Linux, Cupertino and Material pictures of the sheet are byte-identical.
